sources.passage: Design a health insurance claim adjudication assistant for inpatient hospital claims. It should read submitted policy and hospital documents, assess coverage and eligible charges, recommend or process eligible claims, and route exceptions and rejections for review. Policies can change over time and bills may include room-rent limits. Protect personal medical data, explain decisions with evidence and propose any missing rules as assumptions, not verified insurance or medical advice.

Insurer supplies immutable policy editions, endorsements, precedence rules and effective-date selection plus verified structured bill facts. Room-rent proration applies only when the approved policy rule explicitly names affected charge classes. Proposed test-only rule PR1: linked eligible classes use capped daily room amount divided by actual daily room amount, applied once per eligible line with floor rounding; excluded classes stay unchanged. The insurer must approve or replace PR1 before any real linked deduction.
